experiment: R100 cross-encoder reranker (bge-reranker-v2-m3, fine-tuned fold-0) over union-200
verdict: STOP. Fine-tuned text cross-encoder is WORSE than both production LR (0.2879) and the naive union order (0.1483); recall@20 0.259 vs 0.479. Text reranking cannot beat the LR's source-rank/RRF features; confirms R82 (GT scores like its textual neighbors). Do not escalate to 5-fold.
implication: Ranking lever CLOSED too. Retrieval (BGE/E5/GTE), ranking (LR/neural/oracle-probe/cross-encoder), and response (LexDiv/LLM saddle) all exhausted. R92 p11 (0.6364) is the documented ceiling. Competitor nDCG 0.54-0.60 achieved by a method we have not identified.
